source_boundaries: s274 has no horizontal rule and no separate weekday or Shabbat piyyutim, so there are no scripture chains on these pages. Shabbat material appears only as inline parenthetical insertions (three of them), each introduced by the Rashi rubric אם שבת
s274 ends with סֵדֶר מַלְכֻיּוֹתֵנוּ: and the lower third of the page is blank. There is no catchword
s275 is the English facing page. Its Hebrew cues או״א / היום / ארשת are linkage markers only. The shofar heading, both Rashi custom notes, and the קו״ח markers have no English counterpart
Running headers (127 on both pages) are excluded
